learning_objective: 🎯 Let's discover how to arrange different objects to build a beautiful and complete 3D-like scene in our artwork!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Composition is a big word for how we arrange things on our paper. A good scene has items spread out nicely so the drawing looks balanced.
To make a scene look deep, we draw the sky and mountains in the back, trees in the middle, and big flowers or animals right in the front!
We can even make scenes using a shoebox! By cutting out paper trees and characters and pasting them at different distances inside the box, we create a mini 3D world.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Build a Shoebox Ocean Scene!
fun_activity.instructions: Paint the inside of an old box blue. Cut out paper fish, seaweeds, and a shark, and hang them inside with thread to make an amazing 3D underwater world!

quick_recap: ⭐ A great scene has three parts: the front, the middle, and the back.
⭐ Arranging objects carefully makes our artwork look perfectly balanced.
⭐ Dioramas are magical 3D scenes built inside boxes using paper cutouts.
